newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL shares close down on profit-taking, volume up.
newsitem.headline: KL shares close down on profit-taking, volume up.

text.p: Malaysian shares closed lower as investors and punters locked in profits after significant gains in recent weeks.
The bencmark Composite Index of 100 large-capitalised stock ended 2.62 points lower to 1,236.92, while the Second Board index of small-capitalised stocks ended 9.37 points down to 608.32.

"After the K.L. market hit a three-year high recently, investors are somewhat jittery, and this has caused the downturn in the market," said Simon Maughan, head of research at brokers W.I. Carr in Kuala Lumpur.
